An easy recommendation. This game is incredibly addictive, fun and difficult. The game is a side-scrolling rogue-like semi-RPG type of game. You have several classes to play, though you start with only one and must unlock the rest by playing. Each of the classes play wildly different to each other, such as the slow crowd-shredding enforcer or the Acrid which relies on stacking status effects to rapidly kill its foes. Each class has four abilities in the style of MOBA games, and you must collect item found throughout each level to help you survive. There is also a wide variety of enemies and bosses in the game. Both items you have found and enemies/bosses you have killed are added to an encyclopedia in the main menu, which gives a lot of back story to the game and contains many easter eggs. This adds a lot of replay value to the game. The objective of the game is to survive each level by killing enemies, collecting items and finding the teleporter to get to the next level. This can can be very difficult, especially as many of the enemies have abilities which makes the game very interesting to play. The music is also excellent.

A very challanging and amazing fun game that you will never get bored of.
I played in Alpha, and soon as I started playing this game, everything from the soundtrack to epic items made this my favourite rogue-game! Everytime you play is a different playthrough.
If you like randomly generated maps, this game does offers a lot of it, however it can be a bit 'liner'.
Nonetheless, a very good game and a definite buy!

This game is really fun.  Its rouge-like elements keep you on edge and the gameplay is kinda addicting.  Its like one of those games you play at an arcade where you get your butt kicked constantly but for some reason you keep popping quarters into the machine in hopes that you can do better the next time.  What is the definition of insanity again?
Very interesting game. It's a good challenge. Definitely have to put some time into it to become good
